g.text: Sun and Earth visibility shall be calculated
Earth visibility shall use 2 m height and
Turning the road off shall change only the
Round-trip delay shall be sampled from 6 to
10 s. Rover state and status messages
shall update every 60 s, with message
The rover shall not start a new waypoint
without a command, or while Earth is out
of view. A command with no
status message is replaced by the next
one. Drops and resends shall be logged.
The planner shall work out time and energy
from the active speed, slip and load.
Hard limits shall be slope, battery reserve,
and no driving without Earth in view.
The planner shall minimise arrival time, with
an energy penalty of 0.001 h per Wh
The planner may use a coarser grid, but
each plan shall finish within 5 min and the
final route shall be rechecked at full
